name: large-graph-performance-exit-audit

exportContract.nativeDialogBoundary: The real Windows/Tauri save dialog is opened and submitted by the desktop Computer Use harness, preserving its dynamic filesystem grant and the complete production SVG generation, PNG conversion and filesystem write path.
exportContract.svg: metadata and rendered node/edge counts exactly match the current visible graph and all geometry is finite
exportContract.png: valid PNG signature, non-empty finite dimensions, maximum 8192 per side and maximum 32 million pixels

resourceContract.activeCancellation: The initial 1000-node run observes running/pending cancellation; each lifecycle cycle removes only the audit WebView's persisted graph layout before entry, proves a real initial Worker job dispatch, then leaves the graph.
resourceContract.exit: Worker termination and observer disconnection balance after initial exit and after all cycles; tracked listener type counts match the first return-route baseline because the current Markdown editor legitimately owns one keydown listener.

scope: Verify full and current filtered graph SVG/PNG export through the real Tauri filesystem path.
Verify Worker, ResizeObserver and graph window/document listener cleanup under active cancellation.
Verify settled graphs have no continuous Canvas work or long tasks.
Audit remaining non-continuous Canvas and semantic phases against an explicit exit budget.
Close M3C only when performance, export, lifecycle, runtime and source-safety contracts all pass.
deferred: viewport draw culling unless the exit audit fails
label caching unless the exit audit fails

corrections.expected: Lifecycle polling would repeatedly observe the transient Worker running state.
corrections.actual: Fast Worker jobs sometimes completed before polling.
corrections.resolution: Count real Worker postMessage dispatches and verify active cancellation separately.

corrections.expected: The pre-entry route had no graph-related listeners.
corrections.actual: The returned Markdown editor legitimately retained one keydown listener.
corrections.resolution: Compare listener types at the first returned-route baseline with the final returned route.

corrections.expected: Every globally profiled phase belonged to the remaining Canvas/semantic exit budget.
corrections.actual: Backend build-link-graph is a separate first-visible phase.
corrections.resolution: Apply the one-second exit budget only to the enumerated Canvas and semantic phases.

corrections.expected: A complex 5000-node SVG could be decoded into an image before PNG encoding.
corrections.actual: WebView2 rejected the 6.9 MB SVG image decode although the SVG file itself was valid.
corrections.resolution: Render PNG directly from graph nodes, routes and semantic styles on a bounded Canvas.

corrections.expected: Choosing a community closed the community panel.
corrections.actual: The product intentionally retained the panel while applying the 72-node/71-edge filter.
corrections.resolution: Use the real community entry again to close the panel before export; do not change product behavior to fit the harness.

selectedNextStage.name: cross-format-workflow-and-release-candidate-entry-audit
selectedNextStage.reason: M3 semantic exploration, professional visual system and large-graph performance all passed independent exit audits. Freeze the M4 object-location, controlled-conversion, context-return and release-candidate scope before implementation or any version transition.
